entities.summary: LuckyChap Entertainment Limited is a production company based in Los Angeles and Bromsgrove, founded in 2014 by Margot Robbie, Tom Ackerley, Josey McNamara and Sophia Kerr. The company describes their focal point as female-focused film and television productions. LuckyChap Entertainment is a film production company in Americas. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
